# Feature: help-screen
## Purpose
Offer help.
## User outcome
People can recover without technical knowledge.
## Scope and non-goals
Contextual help only.
## Positive flow
Open help and follow the guidance.
## Negative and recovery flow
Missing context still presents general guidance.
## User inputs and visible outcomes
The person asks for help and sees useful instructions.
## Done outcomes
### DC-01 Help appears
Given a screen, when help opens, then relevant guidance appears.
## Subjective user-test questions
Does the guidance feel clear?
## Applicable principles
(none identified)
